subject: Request: Exec OK for 22% discount on Hosted API — BrightHealth AI
messages:
From: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brighthealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API proposal

Thanks Marissa — quick follow up. We reviewed the proposal you sent (attached). The functionality and latency look great, but our procurement has aggressive targets: they want a 25% discount on hosted usage to make the budget work for FY27. We have a competing quote from another provider that is around 24% off list, so price will drive our decision.

If Redwood can match ~25% on a 12-month committed consumption (we're comfortable committing $300k ARR minimum), we're ready to move fast and push Finance to sign in the next 2–3 weeks. Can you advise whether your team can come close to that?

— Alex
Director of Platform Partnerships
BrightHealth AI

Attachment: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brighthealth.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API proposal

Alex — really appreciate the transparency. I attached an updated proposal showing a 18% committed usage discount (12-month term, $300k committed monthly drawdown schedule) plus waived onboarding credits. I showed comparable latency and included a SLO commitment in the SLA appendix.

I don't have authority to go to 25% on-hosted pricing, but I can take this to Deal Desk for expedited review. Can you confirm the $300k ARR commitment and whether the customer needs any on-prem or VPC isolation? If not, I will escalate.

Next steps: confirm commitment amount -> I'll ask Deal Desk for best allowable concession -> bring back to you with a single counter.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Proposal_BrightHealthAI_v2.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Deal Desk <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: —
Date: 2026-10-03T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Hosted API proposal — BrightHealth AI (need recommendation)

Rishi / Karthik — forwarding Alex's reply above. BrightHealth is asking for ~25% on hosted usage for a 12-month, $300k ARR committed contract. I have attached the current proposal and SOW. They are willing to sign quickly if we can get closer to their target.

Please evaluate: list price for expected monthly tokens is $X (see proposal) and an approval >20% will require exec sign-off per policy. Could you run the economics and advise recommended concession (and whether we should attach any guardrails — e.g., minimum monthly burn, no add-on discounts, or auto-revert to standard pricing after 12 months)? We need a formal deal-desk rationale doc to route to exec.

Time is sensitive — procurement expects final numbers by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: FW: Hosted API proposal — BrightHealth AI (deal desk recommendation)

Marissa — reviewed the numbers and competitive context. Summary:
- BrightHealth proposed: 25% off hosted usage list.
- Proposed Redwood counter: 22% off hosted usage (captures most of the customer's target while preserving healthy unit economics).
- Conditions: 12-month firm committed usage at $300k ARR minimum (monthly drawdown schedule), no stacking with other promotional credits, no discounted pricing on add-ons (e.g., dedicated clusters, private deployments) during the term.
- Rationale: Expected payback 9–11 months based on onboarding effort and estimated expansion. Incremental ARR and visibility into health system pilots justify concession to win strategic healthcare reference.

Policy note: any discount >20% requires Exec approval (Sales Discount Policy v2.1). I've prepared a short DealDesk_Rationale_BH-2026-007.pdf with ARR, margin impact, and stakeholder signoffs. Forwarding to exec for approval. Recommended approval text: "Approve 22% committed-hosted discount for 12 months conditional on signed SOW and finance confirmation of billing structure."

Attachments: DealDesk_Rationale_BH-2026-007.pdf, SOW_BR-001.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brighthealth.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Requesting Exec OK: 22% discount for BrightHealth AI (BH-2026-007)

Vivek — quick ask. Deal Desk recommends a one-time concession of 22% off Hosted API usage for BrightHealth AI on a 12-month, $300k ARR committed contract. Customer has competing 24–25% pricing and is ready to sign within 2 weeks if we can match near that level.

Why approval is justified:
- Strategic healthcare customer with high reference value and expansion runway across payer partners.
- Economics: Deal Desk projects payback <12 months and conservative expansion assumptions support long-term revenue.
- Conditions (Deal Desk recommended): 12-month firm commitment, no discount stacking, standard SLA, signoff from Finance on billing cadence.

Attachments: DealDesk_Rationale_BH-2026-007.pdf (contains margin impact), Proposal_BrightHealthAI_v2.pdf, SOW_BR-001.docx

Asks: 1) Approve 22% committed-hosted discount for one year? 2) If yes, please confirm any additional constraints you want included (e.g., auto-revert to list price after 12 months, cap on usage tiers).

Customer is on standby for an answer; procurement wants the counter by Friday EOD.

— Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Finance Ops <finance@redwood.com>, Legal <legal@redwood.com>, Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@brighthealth.ai>
Date: 2026-10-07T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting Exec OK: 22% discount for BrightHealth AI (BH-2026-007)

Marissa / team — approved. I will sign off on a 22% committed-hosted discount for a 12-month term under the following conditions:
1) Minimum committed ARR of $300k guaranteed and documented in the SOW.
2) Discount applies only to Hosted API usage tokens; no discounts to Dedicated/Private deployments or add-on modules during the 12-month period.
3) Pricing reverts to standard list at the end of the 12-month term unless a renewal with new negotiated terms is executed.
4) Finance to confirm billing cadence and that the discount is recognized under our revenue rules. Legal to review SOW redlines and attach amendment.
5) This approval is one-off for BrightHealth AI and must be recorded against deal ID BH-2026-007 in HubSpot (Rishi, please update).

Rishi/Finance/Legal: please coordinate the amendment and send a DocuSign link to Alex. Marissa: please send the customer's procurement the counter (22% on hosted usage) and the attached updated SOW once legal confirms.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
